title: Easetech
description: Development of a modern platform that facilitates document and wayleave workflows between organizations and clients. The system includes user registration, quote requests, document handling, and geospatial data interactions.
detailedDescription: This platform streamlines the complex process of managing documents and wayleave agreements between service providers and their clients. Designed for efficiency and clarity, it allows users to register, submit quote requests, manage and sign documentation, and interact with geospatial data through an intuitive interface. The system ensures seamless communication, transparent workflows, and secure handling of sensitive information, helping organizations reduce manual work and accelerate approval cycles. Built with scalability and user experience in mind, it supports both internal teams and external users in a unified environment.

tickedBoxes.tickedDescription: Different access levels for admins, clients, and engineers
Interactive geospatial tools for land selection
Users can easily submit and track quote requests, ensuring clear communication and efficient response handling
Website is adjusted to different displays' sizes
